item.name: Ask a question
item.description:
Upload a spoken question and read the transcript and the grounded answer.
With the fake STT engine any non-empty audio works; against Whisper use fixtures/question.real.webm.

exec: pm.test('status is one of answer, clarify, abstain, command', () => pm.expect(["answer", "clarify", "abstain", "command"]).to.include(pm.response.json().status));
